sentences.explanation: The sentence is a simple statement indicating that only these things are being referred to.
This sentence only consists of quotation marks, indicating the beginning and end of a quote.

content.raw_text: 赵馨诚点点头，扭头瞟了眼书记员，继续问：“你和刘长永见面的时候，说什么了？”

sentences.text: 赵馨诚点点头，扭头瞟了眼书记员，继续问：“你和刘长永见面的时候，说什么了？
sentences.translation: Zhao Xincheng nodded, turned his head to glance at the secretary, and continued to ask, 'What did you and Liu Changyong talk about when you met?'
sentences.explanation: This sentence contains a question structure with the verb '说' (to say) followed by '什么' (what) to ask about the content of the conversation.
This sentence only consists of opening and closing quotation marks, indicating that there is a quoted text within them.

content.raw_text: 周巡道：“就是商量他去长春调查到的线索该怎么汇报。”

sentences.text: 周巡道：“就是商量他去长春调查到的线索该怎么汇报。
sentences.translation: Zhou Xundao: "It's about discussing how to report the clues he found in Changchun during the investigation."
sentences.explanation: The sentence structure in Chinese is Subject + Verb + Object. The possessive particle '的' is used to indicate possession or association between words. The word '该' is used to express 'should' in this context.
The sentence ends with a quotation mark followed by an ellipsis, indicating a continuation or omission of text.

content.raw_text: 赵馨诚道：“你们队当时在楼里的其他人都听到你和刘长永有争吵，是因为对工作汇报的意见不合么？”

sentences.text: 赵馨诚道：“你们队当时在楼里的其他人都听到你和刘长永有争吵，是因为对工作汇报的意见不合么？
sentences.translation: Zhao Xincheng said, 'Did everyone else in your team in the building hear you and Liu Changyong arguing because you disagreed on the work report?'
sentences.explanation: This sentence involves a question structure using the particle '么' at the end to indicate a yes-no question. The possessive particle '的' is used to show possession or association between '工作' (work) and '汇报' (report).
The sentence contains quotation marks at the beginning and end, indicating a direct quote or emphasized text.

content.raw_text: 周巡一撇嘴：“我也忘了是因为什么了，反正我俩一向合不来。”

sentences.text: 周巡一撇嘴：“我也忘了是因为什么，反正我俩一向合不来。
sentences.translation: Zhou Xun shrugged: "I also forgot why, anyway, the two of us have never gotten along."
sentences.explanation: The sentence uses colloquial language and expressions, such as "一撇嘴" (shrugged) and "一向合不来" (have never gotten along), which may be challenging for intermediate learners.
This sentence only consists of a closing quotation mark and a space.

content.raw_text: 赵馨诚听得直愣，忙扭头对书记员说：“这句不用记！”

sentences.text: 赵馨诚听得直愣，忙扭头对书记员说：“这句不用记！
sentences.translation: Zhao Xincheng listened in a daze, quickly turned his head to the clerk and said, 'You don't need to remember this sentence!'
sentences.explanation: The sentence contains a command structure where the speaker is instructing the clerk not to remember a particular sentence.
This sentence only consists of opening and closing quotation marks, indicating that there is a quoted text within them.

content.raw_text: 周巡反倒笑了笑：“该怎么记怎么记，全队上下都知道我跟老刘不和，但他好歹是我们队的人。我周巡向来枪口朝外，不会冲自己人来。”

sentences.text: 周巡反倒笑了笑：“该怎么记，全队上下都知道我跟老刘不和但他好歹是们的人。
sentences.translation: Zhou Xun smiled back, 'Remember however you want to remember. Everyone in the whole team knows that I don't get along with Lao Liu, but he is still a member of our team.'
sentences.explanation: The sentence showcases the use of the particle '了' to indicate the completion of an action. It also includes the structure '该...怎么记怎么记' which means 'remember however you want to remember'.

sentences.text: 我周巡向来枪口朝外，不会冲自己人来。
sentences.translation: I have always kept my gun pointed outward, never towards my own people.
sentences.explanation: The structure '不会冲自己人来' means 'never towards my own people'. The word '冲' here means 'towards', which might be confusing for learners.
The sentence starts and ends with quotation marks, indicating that it is a direct quote or dialogue.

content.raw_text: 赵馨诚道：“那你和刘长永见面的时候，注意到他屋子里有杯奶茶么？”

sentences.text: 赵馨诚道：“那你和刘长永见面的时候，注意到他屋子里有杯奶茶么？
sentences.translation: Zhao Xincheng said: "When you met Liu Changyong, did you notice if there was a cup of milk tea in his room?"
sentences.explanation: The sentence structure involves asking a question using the particle "么" at the end to indicate a yes-no question. The word order in Chinese is different from English, so pay attention to the placement of words in the sentence.
This sentence only consists of opening and closing quotation marks, indicating that there is quoted text in between.

content.raw_text: 周巡道：“当时没注意，我是后来第二次去办公室找他的时候，才发现他桌上有杯喝的。我折腾了一天，困得要死，还以为是咖啡，打开一闻发现是奶兮兮的东西，就扣上盖儿放那了。”

sentences.text: 周巡道：“当时没注意，我是后来第二次去办公室找他的时候，才发现他桌上有杯喝的。
sentences.translation: Zhou Xundao: "I didn't notice at the time. It was only when I went to his office for the second time that I found a cup on his desk."
sentences.explanation: The sentence structure in Chinese can be quite different from English. In this sentence, the word order is subject + time + action, which may be different from what English speakers are used to.

sentences.text: 我折腾了一天，困得要死，还以为是咖啡，打开一闻发现是奶兮兮的东西，就扣上盖儿放那了。
sentences.translation: I tossed and turned all day, feeling dead tired. I thought it was coffee, but when I opened it and smelled it, I found it was milky stuff, so I put the lid back on and left it there.
sentences.explanation: This sentence showcases the use of particles like 了 and 的, as well as the structure of expressing mistaken beliefs with 以为. The phrase '奶兮兮' is an onomatopoeic term used to describe something milky or creamy.
The sentence is enclosed in quotation marks, indicating that it is a direct quote or dialogue.

content.raw_text: 预审员在一旁道：“就是说你承认在和刘长永发生口角后，又在刘长永不在的情况下，单独进过他的办公室，对么？”

sentences.text: 预审员在一旁道：“就是说你承认在和刘长永发生口角后，又在刘长永不在的情况下，单独进过他的办公室，对么？
sentences.translation: The presiding officer on the side said: "So you admit that after having a dispute with Liu Changyong, you entered his office alone when Liu Changyong was not there, is that correct?"
sentences.explanation: This sentence involves complex grammar structures such as using multiple verbs in sequence and the use of the particle '在' to indicate a specific time or condition.
The sentence ends with a quotation mark and an ellipsis, indicating a continuation or omission of text.

content.raw_text: 周巡摊了摊手：“监控里你们也能看得到，我去的时候又不知道他不在办公室。”

sentences.text: 周巡摊了摊手：“监控里你们也能看得到，我去的时候又不知道他不在办公室。
sentences.translation: Zhou shrugged his shoulders: 'You can also see in the surveillance footage that I didn't know he wasn't in the office when I went.'
sentences.explanation: The structure '我去的时候' means 'when I went', where '的时候' is a common way to indicate 'when' in Chinese.
The sentence is enclosed in quotation marks, indicating that it is a direct quote or dialogue.

content.raw_text: 赵馨诚道：“你俩刚吵完，你又回去找他，为什么？”

sentences.text: 赵馨诚道：“你俩刚吵完，你又回去找他，为什么？
sentences.translation: Zhao Xincheng said, 'You two just finished arguing, why did you go back to find him again?'
sentences.explanation: The sentence structure involves the use of 刚...完...又... to express the sequence of actions in the past tense, followed by a question about the reason for the repeated action.
The sentence contains opening and closing quotation marks.

content.raw_text: 周巡道：“还能为啥，事儿没说完呗。”

sentences.text: 周巡道：“还能为啥，事儿没说完呗。
sentences.translation: Zhou Xundao: "What else could it be, I haven't finished talking about it."
sentences.explanation: The sentence structure is straightforward, but the use of the modal particle '呗' at the end adds a casual and suggestive tone to the speaker's statement.

words.definition: modal particle indicating suggestion or emphasis

sentences.explanation: This sentence consists of opening and closing quotation marks.

content.raw_text: 预审员：“然后你就离开支队了？”

sentences.text: 预审员：“然后你就离开支队了？
sentences.translation: Pre-trial officer: "Then you left the detachment?"
sentences.explanation: The sentence structure in Chinese is Subject + Time/Condition + Verb + Object + Particle. The use of "就" in this context emphasizes the immediacy or straightforwardness of the action.
The sentence consists of a closing quotation mark and a space.

content.raw_text: 周巡道：“是。”

sentences.text: 周巡道：“是。
sentences.translation: Zhou Xundao: "Yes."
sentences.explanation: The sentence is a simple dialogue where Zhou Xundao responds with 'Yes.'

sentences.translation: The white night is long.
sentences.explanation: This sentence simply describes the white night as being long. The structure is subject + adjective + noun + verb.

content.raw_text: 赵馨诚挑了挑眉毛，扭头对预审员和书记员说：“你们俩出去一下，我跟老周单聊几句。”

sentences.text: 赵馨诚挑了挑眉毛，扭头对预审员和书记员说：“你们俩出去一下，我跟老周单聊几句。
sentences.translation: Zhao Xincheng raised an eyebrow, turned to the presiding judge and court clerk, and said, 'The two of you step out for a moment, I want to have a private chat with Lao Zhou.'
sentences.explanation: The sentence involves a request for privacy during a conversation, using the word '单' to indicate chatting alone with someone.
The sentence starts and ends with quotation marks.

content.raw_text: 预审员有些不满：“赵队，这可……”

sentences.text: 预审员有些不满：“赵队，这可…
sentences.translation: The presiding officer was somewhat dissatisfied: 'Captain Zhao, this...
sentences.explanation: The sentence introduces the presiding officer expressing dissatisfaction towards Captain Zhao, but the continuation of the sentence is cut off.

sentences.translation: The night was white, and the moonlight was like frost.
sentences.explanation: This sentence uses similes to describe the moonlight as being similar to frost, which is a common literary device in Chinese writing.

sentences.translation: White Night.
sentences.explanation: This sentence simply means 'White Night.' The tricky part might be the use of the word '白夜' (white night) which refers to the phenomenon of the 'white nights' that occur in some northern regions during summer when the sun does not fully set, creating a twilight-like effect throughout the night.

content.raw_text: 赵馨诚转身双手一撑桌子，身子向前探，一字一顿地说：“出去！”

sentences.text: 赵馨诚转身双手一撑桌子，身子向前探一字一顿地说：“出去！
sentences.translation: Zhao Xincheng turned around, propped the table with both hands, leaned forward, and said each word with emphasis: 'Get out!'
sentences.explanation: This sentence showcases the use of body language and tone to convey a strong command. The repetition of '一字一顿' emphasizes the speaker's seriousness and determination.
This sentence only consists of two quotation marks, indicating the beginning and end of a quote.

content.raw_text: 预审员、书记员两人对视一眼，明显都不大敢撩虎须，乖乖出了审讯室。

sentences.text: 预审员，书记员两人对视一眼，明显都不大敢撩虎须，乖乖出了审讯室。
sentences.translation: The presiding judge and the court clerk exchanged a glance, obviously not daring to provoke the tiger, obediently leaving the interrogation room.
sentences.explanation: The sentence describes the behavior of the presiding judge and the court clerk who exchanged a glance and decided to obediently leave the interrogation room without provoking any trouble.

content.raw_text: 赵馨诚拎起一把椅子，走到周巡面前，和他促膝而坐，表情严肃地问道：“这么多年兄弟，我就不绕弯子了。刘长永的死跟你有关么？”

sentences.text: 赵馨诚拎起一把椅子，走到周巡面前，和他促膝而坐，表情严肃地问道：“这么多年兄弟，我就不绕弯子了。
sentences.translation: Zhao Xincheng picked up a chair, walked to Zhou Xun's side, sat down with him, and asked seriously, 'After so many years of brotherhood, I won't beat around the bush.'
sentences.explanation: The sentence includes a common Chinese idiom '绕弯子' which means 'beat around the bush' or 'not to speak directly'. This sentence shows a direct and serious conversation between two characters.

words.definition: particle to link adverbial and verb

sentences.text: 刘长永的死跟你有关么？
sentences.translation: Is Liu Changyong's death related to you?
sentences.explanation: The sentence structure is a question formed by using the question particle "么" at the end. The possessive particle "的" is used to show possession in Chinese.
This sentence only consists of a closing quotation mark and a blank space, with no actual text content.

content.raw_text: 周巡琢磨了一下，沉声答道：“有。”

sentences.text: 周巡琢磨了一下，沉声答道：“有。
sentences.translation: Zhou pondered for a moment and replied in a deep voice: 'Yes.'
sentences.explanation: The structure '巡琢磨了一下' means 'pondered for a moment'. The use of '沉声' before '答道' emphasizes that the reply was in a deep voice.
The sentence starts and ends with quotation marks, indicating that it is a direct quotation.

content.raw_text: 听到周巡的回答，赵馨诚愣住了。

sentences.text: 听到周巡的回答，赵馨诚愣住了。
sentences.translation: Upon hearing Zhou Xun's answer, Zhao Xin Cheng was stunned.
sentences.explanation: The structure '听到...的回答' means 'hear someone's answer'. The use of '了' at the end of the sentence indicates completion of the action.

content.raw_text: 只听周巡又低声道：“确切地说，从一开始，从2月13号那天开始……所有与那件事有关的人，都和刘长永的死有关。”

sentences.text: 只听周巡又低声道：“确切地说，从一开始，从2月13号那天开始…
sentences.translation: Just listen to Zhou Xun whispering again: "To be precise, from the very beginning, from February 13th...
sentences.explanation: This sentence introduces the speaker Zhou Xun whispering about the precise starting point of a certain event, emphasizing the date of February 13th. The structure '从...开始' is a common way to express 'starting from...' in Chinese.

sentences.translation: The moonlight was shining brightly.
sentences.explanation: The sentence structure in Chinese is Subject + Adverbial + Verb. In this sentence, '月光' (moonlight) is the subject, '明亮' (bright) is the adverbial, and '照' (shine) is the verb.

sentences.text: 所有与那件事有关的人，都和刘长永的死有关。
sentences.translation: All people related to that matter are related to the death of Liu Changyong.
sentences.explanation: The structure '所有...都' emphasizes that all people related to the matter are also related to Liu Changyong's death.
The sentence is enclosed in quotation marks, with a space in between.
This sentence follows the Chinese date and time format, with the year, month, day, hour, and minute specified in sequence.

content.raw_text: 周巡“哗啦”一声把车队的门拉下。由于已经临近大年夜的午夜，冰天雪地里到处都是嘈杂的鞭炮和烟火声。

sentences.text: 周巡“哗啦”一声把车队的门拉下。
sentences.translation: Zhou pulled down the door of the convoy with a 'clatter'.
sentences.explanation: The structure '把...拉下' is a common Chinese grammar pattern where '把' is used to indicate the object of the action and '拉下' means 'pull down'.

words.definition: indicating the object of the verb

sentences.text: 由于已经临近大年夜的午夜，冰天雪地里到处都是嘈杂的鞭炮和烟火声。
sentences.translation: Due to the approaching midnight of the New Year's Eve, the snowy landscape is filled with noisy firecrackers and fireworks.
sentences.explanation: The sentence describes a scene where the snowy landscape is noisy with firecrackers and fireworks due to the approaching midnight of New Year's Eve.

content.raw_text: 他那会儿还不是队长，和队员共享一个办公室，值班就光忙着接各种各样的报案电话……纵火的、把猪腿当人腿报凶杀的，花样不断。

sentences.text: 他那会儿还不是队长，和队员共享一个办公室，值班就光忙着接各种各样的报案电话…
sentences.translation: At that time, he was not yet the team leader, sharing an office with the team members, and during duty, he was busy answering various report calls...
sentences.explanation: This sentence describes the situation where the character was not yet the team leader and shared an office with team members, being busy answering different report calls during duty.

words.definition: particle to mark preceding word as modifier

sentences.translation: The moonlight was like water, flowing through the gaps in the leaves.
sentences.explanation: The sentence uses a simile structure to describe the moonlight flowing through the gaps in the leaves, comparing it to water.

sentences.text: 纵火的，把猪腿当人腿报凶杀的，花样不断。
sentences.translation: The arsonists, who mistook pig legs for human legs and sought revenge, keep coming up with new tricks.
sentences.explanation: The sentence describes the actions of arsonists who mistakenly thought pig legs were human legs and sought revenge by committing murder. The phrase '花样不断' emphasizes that they keep coming up with new tricks or methods.

content.raw_text: 好不容易又处理掉一通，他转身正要出门，在门口和小汪碰上了。

sentences.text: 好不容易又处理掉一通，他转身正要出门，在门口和小汪碰上了。
sentences.translation: With great difficulty, he finished dealing with another call, turned around to leave, and bumped into Xiao Wang at the doorway.
sentences.explanation: This sentence contains the structure '好不容易' which means 'with great difficulty'. Also, '又' is used to indicate the action of dealing with another call happening again.

content.raw_text: 小汪手里拿着几页纸说：“哎，周哥，市局刚发过来通告……哦对，还有刚才110中心转过来一个报案……”

sentences.text: 小汪手里拿着几页纸说：“哎，周哥，市局刚发过来通告…
sentences.translation: Xiao Wang held a few pages of paper in his hand and said, 'Hey, Zhou Ge, the city bureau just sent a notice...
sentences.explanation: The sentence introduces Xiao Wang holding paper and informing Zhou Ge about a notice from the city bureau. The use of '哎' is an informal way to get someone's attention.

sentences.translation: The night was long, and the moon was bright.
sentences.explanation: The sentence describes a long night with a bright moon. The word order in Chinese is different from English.

sentences.text: 哦对，还有刚才110中心转过来一个报案…
sentences.translation: Oh, right, just now 110 center received a report...
sentences.explanation: The structure '还有' is used to indicate 'also' or 'still have'. The term '110' refers to the emergency hotline number in China. '转过来' can be translated as 'received' in this context.

sentences.translation: The white night is coming.
sentences.explanation: The sentence structure is subject + verb + complement. The tricky part for learners might be understanding the use of the verb "来" (coming) to indicate the future tense in this context.
The sentence consists of opening and closing quotation marks.

content.raw_text: 正说着，屋里一张办公桌上的电话又响了。周巡伸手一摁小汪的肩膀，说：“先帮我接个电话，剩下的待会儿再说，我得下楼去收个案子。”

sentences.text: 正说着，屋里一张办公桌上的电话又响了。
sentences.translation: Just as he was speaking, the phone on the desk in the room rang again.
sentences.explanation: This sentence showcases the use of the particle '着' to indicate an ongoing action, as well as the use of '又' to show the repetition of an action.

words.definition: measure word for flat objects like desks
possessive particle, indicating desk belongs to the room

sentences.text: 周巡伸手一摁小汪的肩膀，说：“先帮我接个电话，剩下的待会儿再说，我得下楼去收个案子。
sentences.translation: Zhou Xun reached out and patted Xiao Wang's shoulder, saying, 'Help me answer a phone call first. We'll talk about the rest later. I need to go downstairs to pick up a case.'
sentences.explanation: This sentence showcases the use of imperative form ('先帮我接个电话' - 'Help me answer a phone call first') and the structure '剩下的待会儿再说' which means 'talk about the rest later'.
The sentence is incomplete and ends with a quotation mark, indicating there is more text to follow.

content.raw_text: 周巡正要往外走，一侧头，看见小汪的腰上别着步话机，顺手摘下来，说：“台子我用一下。”

sentences.text: 周巡正要往外走，一侧头，看见小汪的腰上别着步话机，顺手摘下来，说：“台子我用一下。
sentences.translation: Zhou Xunzheng was about to leave, turned his head, saw Xiao Wang's waist with a walkie-talkie attached, took it off casually, and said, "I'll borrow the table for a bit."
sentences.explanation: The sentence showcases the use of directional verbs '往' (towards) and '走' (to walk), as well as the possessive particle '的' (of). Additionally, the verb '顺手' (casually) is used to describe the action of taking something off.
The sentence starts and ends with quotation marks, indicating that it is a direct quote or dialogue.

content.raw_text: 不等小汪有反应，他就跑出了办公室，顺着楼梯一边跑一边对着话台说：“二探组，二探组回话！远洋山水小区对面的洗浴中心刚接到纵火报案。派出所已经过去了，你们去现场勘查一下，看看到底又是哪个缺心眼的把二踢脚崩到人房顶上了。到现场之后跟我说一声，辛苦了哥儿几个。”

sentences.text: 不等小汪有反应，他就跑出了办公室，顺着楼梯一边跑一边对着话台说：“二探组，二探组回话！
sentences.translation: Without waiting for Xiao Wang's reaction, he ran out of the office, running down the stairs and shouting towards the reception desk: 'Second Investigation Team, Second Investigation Team, respond!'
sentences.explanation: This sentence contains a structure where the action of running and speaking simultaneously is described using '一边...一边...' (one side...one side...). Additionally, the term '二探组' refers to the 'Second Investigation Team' and is repeated for emphasis.

sentences.text: 远洋山水小区对面的洗浴中心刚接到纵火报案。
sentences.translation: The bath center across from the Overseas Mountain Waters community just received an arson report.
sentences.explanation: This sentence introduces the location of the bath center across from the community and reports that it has just received an arson report. The structure '刚...接到' means 'just received' in this context.

sentences.text: 派出所已经过去了，你们去现场勘查一下，看看到底又是哪个缺心眼的把二踢脚崩到人房顶上。
sentences.translation: The police station has already gone. You guys go to the scene to investigate and see which idiot kicked the ball onto the roof again.
sentences.explanation: The sentence involves a colloquial expression '缺心眼' which means 'idiot' or 'fool'. The structure '把...崩到...' means 'kick...onto...' in this context.

words.definition: indicating the object of the verb

sentences.text: 到现场之后跟我说一声，辛苦了哥儿几个。
sentences.translation: After arriving at the scene, let me know, brothers, you've worked hard.
sentences.explanation: The phrase '一声' is used here as an idiom to mean 'let me know'. The term '哥儿几个' is a colloquial expression referring to 'brothers' or 'buddies'.

sentences.translation: The white night is silent.
sentences.explanation: The sentence describes the white night as being silent. The structure is simple, with '是' (is) linking the subject '白夜' (white night) to the predicate '寂' (silent).

sentences.text: 她只多买了一杯，恐怕是给某个领导。
sentences.translation: She only bought one more cup, probably for some leader.
sentences.explanation: The structure '是...给...' is commonly used to indicate the purpose of an action, in this case, buying the cup for a leader.

sentences.text: 从隶属关系上推断，可能性最大的应该是‘关宏峰’—
sentences.translation: From the perspective of the subordinate relationship, the most likely one should be 'Guan Hongfeng'—
sentences.explanation: The sentence discusses the likelihood of 'Guan Hongfeng' based on the subordinate relationship, using the structure '从...上推断' (infer from).
The sentence consists of a dash/em dash, which is used to indicate a break or pause in the text.

sentences.text: 他只是也不在意毒死其他人罢了。
sentences.translation: He simply didn't care about poisoning others.
sentences.explanation: The structure '也不在意' means 'not care about' in this context, and '罢了' is used to indicate 'just' at the end of the sentence.
The sentence contains a closing quotation mark.

content.raw_text: 刘音琢磨着关宏宇的话，问道：“周舒桐回到面包店去取手机，一来一回也就一分钟，凶手是趁这个时机下的毒么？”

sentences.text: 刘音琢磨着关宏宇的话，问道：“周舒桐回到面包店去取手机，一来一回也就一分钟，凶手是趁这个时机下的毒么？
sentences.translation: Liu Yin pondered Guan Hongyu's words and asked, 'When Zhou Shutong went back to the bakery to get her phone, it only took a minute round trip. Did the killer take advantage of this time to poison her?'
sentences.explanation: The sentence involves a complex structure with multiple clauses and the use of particles like '着' and '的' to indicate ongoing actions and possession respectively.
The sentence provided is enclosed in quotation marks, indicating that it is a direct quote or specific text being referenced.

content.raw_text: 关宏峰琢磨道：“应该是，开警车外出，不锁或忘锁车是常事儿。因为开的是警车嘛……总觉得一般不会有人敢去碰，再加上武器和话台都是随身携带，车里确实没什么可偷的。”

sentences.text: 关宏峰琢磨道：“应该是，开警车外出，不锁或忘锁车是常事儿。
sentences.translation: Guan Hongfeng pondered: "It should be a common thing for police cars to go out without being locked or forgotten to be locked."
sentences.explanation: The sentence structure in Chinese is Subject + Verb + Object. The use of '或' (or) in the sentence indicates two possible actions - not locking the car or forgetting to lock the car. The term '常事儿' is a colloquial expression meaning 'common thing'.

words.definition: (particle used to indicate speech or train of thought)

sentences.text: 因为开的是警车嘛…
sentences.translation: Because it's a police car...
sentences.explanation: The sentence structure is Subject + 因为 (because) + Reason. The particle 嘛 at the end is used to express an obvious or self-evident fact.
The sentence ends with an ellipsis followed by a period, indicating a pause or continuation in the text.

sentences.text: 总觉得一般不会有人敢去碰，再加上武器和话台都是随身携带，车里确实没什么可偷的。
sentences.translation: Always feel that generally no one would dare to touch, plus weapons and the dialogue platform are carried with them, there is really nothing to steal in the car.
sentences.explanation: The sentence describes a situation where the speaker feels that no one would dare to touch something because weapons and the dialogue platform are carried with them, and there is nothing valuable to steal in the car.
This sentence only consists of a closing quotation mark and a space, with no actual content to translate.

content.raw_text: 关宏宇恨恨地咬着牙：“姓叶的这小子，还真是见缝插针不落空啊。”

sentences.text: 关宏宇恨恨地咬着牙：“姓叶的这小子，还真是见缝插针不落空啊。
sentences.translation: Guan Hongyu gritted his teeth and said angrily: "This kid surnamed Ye really knows how to seize every opportunity."
sentences.explanation: The structure '见缝插针' is an idiom meaning 'to seize every opportunity'. The sentence structure '还真是' emphasizes the speaker's sentiment.

words.definition: used to link an adverbial modifier

sentences.explanation: The sentence contains a closing quotation mark and an ellipsis, which are important punctuation marks to note in Chinese text.

content.raw_text: 崔虎来回看着兄弟二人的脸色，支吾道：“咱……咱们可还，还没看到开本，本田的就，就，就是他……”

sentences.text: 崔虎来回看着兄弟二人的脸色，支吾道：“咱…
sentences.translation: Cui Hu looked back and forth at the faces of the two brothers, hesitatingly said: "We...
sentences.explanation: The sentence shows Cui Hu looking at the two brothers' facial expressions and hesitatingly starting to say something.

sentences.translation: The moonlight is like water, flowing quietly.
sentences.explanation: The sentence uses a simile structure to describe the moonlight as being similar to water, flowing quietly.

sentences.text: 咱们可还，还没看到开本，本田的就，就，就是他…
sentences.translation: We haven't seen the Honda's edition yet, that's just, just, it's him...
sentences.explanation: The repetition of the word '就' in this sentence emphasizes the speaker's point or feeling, which can be a common rhetorical device in Chinese.

sentences.translation: The moonlight is like a silver plate, shining on the earth.
sentences.explanation: The sentence uses a simile structure to describe the moonlight shining on the earth.
The sentence is enclosed in quotation marks, indicating that it is a direct quote or dialogue.

content.raw_text: 关宏峰低声道：“可就这段时间咱们追寻到的线索，基本都和他有关……他在伍玲玲死的那晚捡到了枪，交给李鹏程，然后指使他袭击支队夺取卷宗。安廷死前见的最后一个人是他，他还是宏宇那个案子的目击证人。金山那个案子，他明显是跟着我们，朴森最后写出的名字，也是他——这些不可能全是巧合。”

sentences.text: 关宏峰低声道：“可就这段时间咱们追寻到的线索，基本都和他有关…
sentences.translation: Guan Hongfeng whispered, 'Most of the clues we have found during this period are basically related to him...
sentences.explanation: The sentence structure in Chinese places the subject before the verb, and the word order is different from English. The use of '可' here emphasizes 'most' of the clues found during a specific period.

sentences.translation: The moonlight was bright and clear.
sentences.explanation: The sentence describes the brightness and clarity of the moonlight in the scene.

sentences.text: 他在伍玲玲死的那晚捡到了枪，交给李鹏程，然后指使他袭击支队夺取卷宗。
sentences.translation: That night when Wu Lingling died, he picked up a gun, handed it to Li Pengcheng, and then instructed him to attack the detachment to seize the file.
sentences.explanation: This sentence showcases the use of complex sentence structures in Chinese, including possessive particles and the sequence of actions in a narrative.

sentences.text: 安廷死前见的最后一个人是他，他还是宏宇那个案子的目击证人。
sentences.translation: Before Anting died, the last person he saw was him, who was still a witness in the Hongyu case.
sentences.explanation: The sentence structure in Chinese can be different from English, with the possessive particle '的' used to indicate possession or relationship between words.

sentences.text: 金山那个案子，他明显是跟着我们，朴森最后写出的名字，也是他—
sentences.translation: In the Jinshan case, he clearly followed us, and the name Parkson wrote in the end was also his—
sentences.explanation: The sentence describes a situation where someone followed the speaker and their group, and the name written by Parkson at the end was also related to that person.
The em dash is used in Chinese text to indicate a break or interruption in the narrative.

words.definition: em dash (indicating a break or interruption)

sentences.text: 这些不可能全是巧合。
sentences.translation: These cannot all be coincidences.
sentences.explanation: The structure '不可能' means 'cannot' or 'impossible' in this context. 巧合 means 'coincidences' or 'coincidental' in this sentence.
This sentence only consists of a closing quotation mark and a space.

content.raw_text: 刘音低声问：“他策划了这么多事情，目的是什么呢？”

sentences.text: 刘音低声问：“他策划了这么多事情，目的是什么呢？
sentences.translation: Liu Yin asked softly, "What is his purpose in planning so many things?"
sentences.explanation: The sentence structure is a question formed by the subject '他' (he), the verb '策划' (plan), and the object '这么多事情' (so many things). The question is asking about the purpose '目的' (purpose) behind the actions of '他' (he).

words.definition: particle indicating completion of an action
(used at the end of a sentence to express inquiry)

sentences.explanation: The sentence contains opening and closing quotation marks.

content.raw_text: 关宏峰沉声道：“这些事儿不是他策划的，他只是个执行者。”

sentences.text: 关宏峰沉声道：“这些事儿不是他策划的，他只是个执行者。
sentences.translation: Guan Hongfeng said in a deep voice: "These things were not planned by him, he is just an executor."
sentences.explanation: This sentence contains a possessive structure using the particle '的' to indicate possession. It also introduces the term '执行者' (executor) which might be new vocabulary for learners.
The sentence consists of opening and closing quotation marks.

content.raw_text: 正在这时，关宏宇身上的手机响了，他掏出手机，递了过去：“咱俩都在的时候，我就不再演戏了。你接吧。”

sentences.text: 正在这时，关宏宇身上的手机响了，他掏出手机，递了过去：“咱俩都在的时候，我就不再演戏了。
sentences.translation: At this moment, Guan Hongyu's phone rang, he took out the phone and handed it over: 'When both of us are present, I won't act anymore.'
sentences.explanation: The sentence demonstrates the use of possessive particles '的' and '了', as well as the structure '就...了' to indicate 'no longer' doing something.

words.definition: particle indicating completion of an action
particle indicating completion of an action

sentences.text: 你接吧。
sentences.translation: You take it.
sentences.explanation: The sentence is a simple command asking someone to take something. The particle 吧 at the end softens the tone of the command.

words.definition: modal particle indicating suggestion or softening of tone

sentences.explanation: This sentence only contains a closing quotation mark and a space.

content.raw_text: 关宏峰走开几步，接通了电话。

sentences.text: 关宏峰走开几步，接通了电话。
sentences.translation: Guan Hongfeng took a few steps away and answered the phone.
sentences.explanation: The structure '接通了电话' means 'answered the phone'. The particle '了' indicates the completion of the action.

content.raw_text: 随后，关宏宇接着向刘音低声解释道：“这些事儿的规模牵扯到非常复杂的情报来源、人员调度还有对各类司法机构运作机制的渗透。叶方舟只是个小崽子，光凭他做不到这个程度。说起来，朴森……”

sentences.text: 随后，关宏宇接着向刘音低声解释道：“这些事儿的规模牵扯到非常复杂的情报来源，人员调度还有对各类司法机构运作机制的渗透。
sentences.translation: Later, Guan Hongyu continued to explain to Liu Yin in a low voice, 'The scale of these matters involves very complex intelligence sources, personnel scheduling, and the infiltration of various judicial institutions' operational mechanisms.'
sentences.explanation: This sentence contains complex vocabulary related to intelligence, personnel, and judicial institutions, which may be challenging for intermediate learners.

words.definition: (modal particle used at the end of a sentence to indicate a statement)

sentences.text: 叶方舟只是个小崽子，光凭他做不到这个程度。
sentences.translation: Ye Fangzhou is just a little kid, he alone cannot achieve this level.
sentences.explanation: The sentence emphasizes that Ye Fangzhou is young and inexperienced, hence unable to achieve the level mentioned.

sentences.text: 说起来，朴森…
sentences.translation: Speaking of, Park Sen...
sentences.explanation: The phrase '说起来' is used to introduce a topic or start talking about something. '朴森' is a name, 'Park Sen'.

sentences.translation: The sky was getting brighter and brighter.
sentences.explanation: The structure '越来越' is used to indicate that something is becoming more and more intense or frequent.
This sentence only consists of opening and closing quotation marks, indicating that there is a quoted text within them.

content.raw_text: 崔虎扭头看了眼电脑上的显示时间：“林嘉茵的飞机已经起飞了。”

sentences.text: 崔虎扭头看了眼电脑上的显示时间：“林嘉茵的飞机已经起飞了。
sentences.translation: Cui Hu turned his head to look at the displayed time on the computer: "Lin Jiayin's plane has already taken off."
sentences.explanation: The sentence structure follows the pattern of Subject + Verb + Object. The use of "了" after a verb indicates the completion of the action. The possessive particle "的" is used to show possession or association.
The sentence consists of opening and closing quotation marks.

content.raw_text: 关宏峰挂断电话，走了回来，脸上的表情有些犹疑不定，其他人都探询地望着他。他深深吸了一口气，缓缓道：“市局指派施广陵降级调任长丰支队，他现在是主事儿的。”

sentences.text: 关宏峰挂断电话，走了回来，脸上的表情有些犹疑不定，其他人都探询地望着他。
sentences.translation: Guan Hongfeng hung up the phone, walked back, his expression somewhat hesitant and uncertain, while the others looked at him inquiringly.
sentences.explanation: The sentence describes Guan Hongfeng hanging up the phone, returning with a hesitant expression on his face, while others look at him inquiringly.

sentences.text: 他深深吸了一口气，缓缓道：“市局指派施广陵降级调任长丰支队，他现在是主事儿的。
sentences.translation: He took a deep breath and said slowly, "The bureau assigned Shi Guangling to be demoted and transferred to Changfeng Branch. He is in charge now."
sentences.explanation: This sentence contains a formal announcement of a demotion and transfer of a person to another department. The structure of the sentence is straightforward, with the main subject and action clearly stated.
The sentence contains opening and closing quotation marks, indicating that the text is a direct quote or dialogue.

content.raw_text: 关宏宇眨眨眼：“我记得你好像说过，他原来就是长丰出去的。现在局面这么难看，派个老手来坐镇，也说得通。”

sentences.text: 关宏宇眨眨眼：“我记得你好像说过，他原来就是长丰出去的。
sentences.translation: Guan Hongyu blinked his eyes: "I remember you said that he originally came from Changfeng."
sentences.explanation: The structure '原来就是' emphasizes the fact that 'he originally came from Changfeng.'

sentences.text: 现在局面这么难看，派个老手来坐镇，也说得通。
sentences.translation: Now that the situation is so ugly, it makes sense to send an old hand to take charge.
sentences.explanation: The structure '也说得通' is an idiomatic expression meaning 'it makes sense'.
The sentence consists of opening and closing quotation marks.

content.raw_text: 关宏峰不置可否地苦笑了一下：“他刚直接打电话给我，‘关宏峰’的顾问身份已经恢复了。”

sentences.text: 关宏峰不置可否地苦笑了一下：“他刚直接打电话给我，‘关宏峰’的顾问身份已经恢复了。
sentences.translation: Guan Hongfeng smiled bitterly without commenting: 'He just called me directly, and my role as Guan Hongfeng's advisor has been restored.'
sentences.explanation: This sentence showcases the use of direct speech in Chinese, as well as the structure of indicating completion of an action with the particle '了'. The phrase '不置可否' is a set phrase meaning 'without commenting or expressing an opinion'.
This sentence only consists of a closing quotation mark and a space.

content.raw_text: 施广陵坐在办公桌后，脸部表情并不怎么严肃，他望着对面站着的关宏峰、周舒桐和赵茜，神色相对比较温和。安抚了周舒桐一番后，他郑重地道：“于情、于理、于规定，你现在都应该暂停工作。可话里话外我也听出来了，虽说是海港支队一直在查，但你肯定不想置身事外。这样吧，这些日子，你时间自己安排。听说那边正在验尸，你想干什么我不管，也管不了，小关、小赵，你们尽量陪着她。”

sentences.text: 施广陵坐在办公桌后，脸部表情并不怎么严肃，他望着对面站着的关宏峰，周舒桐和赵茜，神色相对比较温和。
sentences.translation: Shi Guangling sat behind his desk, his facial expression not very serious, he looked at Guan Hongfeng, Zhou Shutong, and Zhao Qian standing opposite, his expression relatively gentle.
sentences.explanation: This sentence describes Shi Guangling's demeanor as not very serious while looking at Guan Hongfeng, Zhou Shutong, and Zhao Qian, who are standing opposite him with a relatively gentle expression.

sentences.text: 安抚了周舒桐一番后，他郑重地道：“于情，于理，于规定，你现在都应该暂停工作。
sentences.translation: After comforting Zhou Shutong, he solemnly said, 'In terms of emotion, reason, and regulations, you should now suspend your work.'
sentences.explanation: The sentence uses the structure '于...、于...、于...' to list different aspects, which is a formal way of expression in Chinese.

sentences.text: 可话里话外我也听出来了，虽说是海港支队一直在查，但你肯定不想置身事外。
sentences.translation: But I also heard from your words and between the lines, although the maritime police have been investigating all along, you definitely do not want to stay out of it.
sentences.explanation: The sentence structure involves expressing understanding or inference based on what was heard, along with the speaker's reluctance to stay out of a certain situation despite ongoing investigations by the maritime police team.

sentences.text: 这样吧，这些日子，你时间自己安排。
sentences.translation: Let's do it this way, arrange your time by yourself these days.
sentences.explanation: The structure '这样吧' is a common way to suggest doing something in a certain way in Chinese. The phrase '自己安排' means 'arrange by oneself'.

sentences.text: 听说那边正在验尸，你想干什么我不管，也管不了，小关，小赵，你们尽量陪着她。
sentences.translation: I heard they are conducting autopsies over there. I don't care what you want to do, I can't control it either. Xiao Guan, Xiao Zhao, try to accompany her as much as possible.
sentences.explanation: The sentence contains a complex structure with multiple clauses. The use of '管不了' indicates inability to control, and '尽量' suggests trying one's best. The names 'Xiao Guan' and 'Xiao Zhao' are specific to individuals.
This sentence consists of opening and closing quotation marks.

content.raw_text: 说着，他伸手指了下赵茜：“我看档案上说，你俩好像是同期，我不想这段日子小周出什么事儿。”

sentences.text: 说着，他伸手指了下赵茜：“我看档案上说，你俩好像是同期，我不想这段日子小周出什么事儿。
sentences.translation: Saying this, he pointed at Zhao Qian: 'I checked the files and it seems like you two are from the same period. I don't want Xiao Zhou to get into any trouble during this time.'
sentences.explanation: The sentence uses a complex structure with multiple clauses and a possessive construction. The term '同期' is a key vocabulary word meaning 'from the same period'.
The sentence is enclosed in quotation marks, indicating that it is a direct quote or dialogue.

content.raw_text: 说完，他摆摆手，示意谈话结束，三人打过招呼后，也先后走出办公室。

sentences.text: 说完，他摆摆手，示意谈话结束，三人打过招呼后，也先后走出办公室。
sentences.translation: After speaking, he waved his hand, indicating the end of the conversation. After exchanging greetings, the three of them also walked out of the office one after another.
sentences.explanation: This sentence showcases the use of various verbs and conjunctions commonly used in Chinese to indicate sequence of actions and communication cues.

content.raw_text: 走到门口，关宏峰特意停下脚步，道：“施局，您特意召我回来，就是为了确保小周不会出什么事儿？”

sentences.text: 走到门口，关宏峰特意停下脚步，道：“施局，您特意召我回来，就是为了确保小周不会出什么事儿？
sentences.translation: Walking to the door, Guan Hongfeng deliberately stopped and asked, 'Director Shi, did you call me back just to ensure that Xiao Zhou won't get into any trouble?'
sentences.explanation: This sentence includes the structure '就是为了' which means 'just to' or 'for the purpose of'. It also shows the use of '特意' meaning 'deliberately' to emphasize an action.
The sentence contains opening and closing quotation marks.

content.raw_text: 施广陵白了他一眼：“我刚才都说了，那是小赵的事儿。你的任务跟她差不多，中间加个‘搞’字就行了。”

sentences.text: 施广陵白了他一眼：“我刚才都说了，那是小赵的事儿。
sentences.translation: Shi Guangling gave him a white look: "I just said, that's Xiao Zhao's business."
sentences.explanation: The structure '刚才都说了' means 'just said'. The term '白了他一眼' is an idiom meaning 'gave him a disdainful look'.

words.definition: give a white look (a gesture of disdain)

sentences.text: 你的任务跟她差不多，中间加个‘搞’字就行了。
sentences.translation: Your task is similar to hers, just add the word 'do' in the middle.
sentences.explanation: The structure '跟...差不多' means 'similar to' in this context. The use of '加个‘搞’字' is an idiomatic expression meaning 'just add the word 'do'.'
This sentence only consists of a closing quotation mark and a space.

content.raw_text: 关宏峰一挑眉毛，转身离开。

sentences.text: 关宏峰一挑眉毛，转身离开。
sentences.translation: Guan Hongfeng raised an eyebrow and turned away.
sentences.explanation: The sentence structure is Subject + Verb + Object. The verb '挑' is used to describe the action of raising an eyebrow.

content.raw_text: 周舒桐出了支队，直接朝车队的方向走去。

sentences.text: 周舒桐出了支队，直接朝车队的方向走去。
sentences.translation: Zhou Shutong left the detachment and walked directly towards the direction of the convoy.
sentences.explanation: The structure '直接...走去' means 'walk directly towards'. The possessive particle '的' is used to indicate 'the direction of the convoy'.
